graphs.title: A bigger final mass means a bigger percentage gain.
graphs.label: Change in mass

sentences: Set the final mass to 6 g and then to 14 g and compare the sign of the change.
title: Osmosis in potato: percentage change in mass
goal: Find the percentage change in the mass of a potato strip after it is left in a solution.
note: A potato strip gains mass in a solution that is more dilute than its cell sap because water enters by osmosis, and loses mass in a more concentrated solution. The percentage change in mass is the change divided by the starting mass, shown as a percentage. This strip started at 10 g.

concept_check.question: A potato strip has a final mass less than its starting mass. What is the sign of the percentage change?
concept_check.explanation: The strip lost mass, so the change is negative: water left the cells by osmosis.
